title: Location Details

fields.label: Type
fields.name: location_type
fields.instructions: e.g. Classroom, Studio, Office. Matches the `type` column on the `location` table in database/schema.sql.

description: Post Title = the location's name (e.g. "Studio B", "Room 204").

title: Class / Subject Details

fields.label: Teacher
fields.name: subject_teacher
fields.instructions: The teacher who teaches this class. Matches `subject.teacher_id` in database/schema.sql.

fields.label: Classroom
fields.name: subject_location
fields.instructions: The classroom assigned to this class (not to the teacher). Matches `subject.location_id` in database/schema.sql. A peer tutor assigned to this subject inherits this classroom automatically — nothing extra to fill in for them.

description: Post Title = the class/subject name (e.g. "Photography I"). Note: this CPT is informational only — it does not drive the actual booking calendar. Teacher availability/scheduling for real bookings is configured separately inside the MotoPress Appointment Booking plugin (see README).

title: Product Details

fields.label: Size
fields.name: product_size
fields.instructions: e.g. 8x10, 11x14. Leave blank for products with no size (e.g. Pullover). Matches `product.size`.

fields.label: Category
fields.name: product_category
fields.instructions: Matches the `product.category` ENUM in database/schema.sql — do not add new options here without also updating the schema and the Goods form.

description: Post Title = the product's name (e.g. "Photo paper", "Pullover").

title: Event Details
description: Post Title = the event's name. Post Content (the normal WordPress editor below the title) = the event's description — no separate ACF field needed for that.

title: Photographer Details

fields.label: Student ID
fields.name: photographer_student_id
fields.instructions: The student ID of the student who holds the photographer role. Matches `photographer.student_id` in database/schema.sql. Set the Post Title to this same ID.

description: Not every student is a photographer — only create a post here for students who hold that role. How a student earns this role is still an open decision (see README).

title: Peer Tutor Details

fields.label: Student ID
fields.name: peer_tutor_student_id
fields.instructions: The tutor's student ID. Matches `peer_tutor.student_id` in database/schema.sql.

fields.label: Subject
fields.name: peer_tutor_subject
fields.instructions: The subject this student tutors. Matches `peer_tutor.subject_id`. The classroom shown for this tutor comes from the subject's own Classroom field — don't set one here separately.

description: Post Title = the tutor's display name, typed in by the admin/teacher (the Volunteer Form submission that started this only carries the student's ID, never a name). Only create a post here once the request has been reviewed and approved — a post existing here IS the approval; there's no separate status field.
